name: SB236057
summary: SB-236057 is a compound which is a potent and selective inverse agonist for the serotonin receptor 5-HT1B, acting especially at 5-HT1B autoreceptors on nerve terminals. It produces a rapid increase in serotonin levels in the brain, and was originally researched as a potential antidepressant.

pharmacology.text: SB-236057 is a compound which is a potent and selective inverse agonist for the serotonin receptor 5-HT1B, acting especially at 5-HT1B autoreceptors on nerve terminals.

uses.text: The drug was under development by GlaxoSmithKline for the treatment of major depressive disorder in the 2000s and reached the preclinical research stage of development but was never marketed.
